inventive_nucleus: Incorporating short carbon fibers into PMMA bone cement enhances its mechanical properties.

claim_versions.claim: A method of enhancing the mechanical properties of PMMA bone cement, comprising the steps of: (a) selecting a specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material, wherein the short carbon fibers are dispersed in a non-uniform pattern; and (b) incorporating the short carbon fibers into the PMMA bone cement.

redesign.new_claim: A method of enhancing the mechanical properties of PMMA bone cement, comprising the steps of: (a) selecting a specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material, wherein the short carbon fibers are dispersed in a non-uniform pattern; and (b) incorporating the short carbon fibers into the PMMA bone cement.
redesign.change: Added a specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material, and changed the functional requirement to a method of enhancing the mechanical properties.
redesign.reason: This redesigned claim focuses on the operating condition, which is the specific arrangement of the short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material. This makes the claim more specific and distinguishes it from the prior art.

new_elements.technical_feature: specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material
non-uniform pattern of short carbon fibers

claim_versions.claim: A method of enhancing the mechanical properties of PMMA bone cement, comprising the steps of: (a) selecting a specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material, wherein the short carbon fibers are dispersed in a non-uniform pattern, and the arrangement is optimized for a specific loading condition; and (b) incorporating the short carbon fibers into the PMMA bone cement.

redesign.new_claim: A method of enhancing the mechanical properties of PMMA bone cement, comprising the steps of: (a) selecting a specific arrangement of short carbon fibers within the polymer matrix material, wherein the short carbon fibers are dispersed in a non-uniform pattern, and the arrangement is optimized for a specific loading condition; and (b) incorporating the short carbon fibers into the PMMA bone cement.
redesign.change: added 'optimized for a specific loading condition' to element A
redesign.reason: This change should survive the prior-art attack because it introduces a new technical relationship between the specific arrangement of short carbon fibers and the loading condition, which is not explicitly disclosed in the prior art. The prior art references (US 2011/0203456, US 2009/0111111, and WO 2010/013456) do not provide a clear teaching of how to optimize the arrangement of short carbon fibers for a specific loading condition, and a skilled person would not expect that combining the individual components would lead to an improvement in the mechanical properties of PMMA bone cement under specific loading conditions.
